[EN] Hope Chests Spring Eternal

[EN] I'm going broke without my merchandise!

[EN] Thanks. You've saved me a lot of money.
[ES] Gracias. Me has ahorrado mucho dinero.

[EN] "Time to find a new shop."

[EN] Go to the Brigand's Den in Blood Run and search the chests for stolen valuables.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return the chests to Foledus.
[ES] Devuelve los cofres a Foledus.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
